_comment: Pinned fixed WebView2 runtime (x64) for the offline portable build. The 'version' + 'sha256' fields are kept fresh by .github/workflows/webview2-sync.yml. 'sha256' is the real SHA-256 of the vendored CAB and IS verified by release.yml / verify-wv2-dl.yml. The CAB is vendored into the repo under vendor/ and tracked by Git LFS (see .gitattributes) because the old hosting host 'msedgedl.blob.core.windows.net' no longer resolves (verified 2026-08-13 in CI + sandbox). 'localPath' points to the vendored file (used by release.yml — release.yml no longer falls back to any download URL since the legacy host is dead). 'sourceUrl' is the current Microsoft delivery CDN URL for this exact build, used to refresh the vendored CAB when bumping the version. NOTE: 'downloadUrl' / 'downloadUrlTemplate' were removed (P2-1) — they pointed at the dead host and must never be reintroduced.
